annotations.title: Screen against US export-control lists and the UFLPA Entity List (paid)

description: Use before buying from, selling to or shipping to a company, above all a Chinese or Russian one: screens the name against the US Consolidated Screening List (Commerce, State and Treasury export-control lists, without the SDN list, which the sanctions screen covers) and the DHS UFLPA Entity List (forced-labour import ban). These restrict trade, they are not asset freezes. Input: name, optional type (entity or person), threshold. Costs 0.005 USDC via x402, or 3 credits of a Factline API key. The first 5 paid-tool calls a day are free, no payment or key needed.

name.description: Company or person name, e.g. 'Hoshine Silicon Industry'
